text: Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification The same 2D Euler isentropic-vortex family is evolved at background Mach numbers .1 and .01 on 16², 32² and 64² grids to T=.1. Both Roe variants use unlimited central primitive-variable MUSCL reconstruction and SSPRK(3,3); one preconditions numerical dissipation with a Miczek-type matrix. Physical time and acoustic CFL=.2 are retained. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-low-mach-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification The same nonlinear 2D Euler vortex is evolved to T=0.1 on N=16/32/64 at background Mach 0.1/0.01, comparing ordinary Roe with Miczek spatial flux preconditioning. Twelve fixed runs retain velocity and dynamically scaled pressure errors, conserved budgets, acoustic steps and actual stage states. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic [-10,10]^2, gamma=1.4, beta=3, background density 1 and velocity (1,0.5). Set p_infinity=|U_infinity|^2/(gamma M_infinity^2), retaining the same flow and vortex strengths. Background Mach is not maximum local Mach. A whole-plane translating isentropic vortex is evaluated with minimum-image coordinates and a separately qualified Gaussian seam. Conserved cell means use eight-point tensor Gauss quadrature, checked against order 16; they are not closed-form exact means or a generic exactly periodic nonlinear vortex. Editorial clarification The implementation preconditions the numerical-flux dissipation matrix D=P⁻¹|PA|. It does not implement steady pseudo-time or dual-time acceleration, or validate an explicit convective time step. The SSPRK(3,3) name alone does not supply strong-stability or nonlinear positivity guarantees; fixed runs and sampled constant-state Fourier modes have distinct scopes. At the finest M∞=.01 grid, velocity error and vortex kinetic-energy retention improve, but whole-domain dynamically normalized pressure L1 is about .01194 for ordinary Roe and .01260 for preconditioned Roe. Pressure error is not uniformly improved. The vorticity/velocity-perturbation illustration is a central crop; diagnostics distinguish the whole box from a fixed core. Adopted numerical method Both finite-volume variants use the same unlimited centered primitive-MUSCL reconstruction, the physical Euler flux and SSPRK(3,3); only Roe dissipation is replaced by D=P^-1|PA|. At each Roe state use the total-speed Mach with mu=min(1,max(M_local,M_infinity)) and delta=1/mu-1, applying the primitive Miczek matrix through conserved-variable Jacobians. A degree-two characteristic polynomial applies the matrix absolute value; a separate dense eigendecomposition checks it. Physical time and sound speed are unchanged; acoustic CFL=0.2 remains. Reconstructed faces and all three stages check positive density and pressure, without limiters, floors, repair, hidden retries or pseudo-time iteration. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution. Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01. Verification limits and failures This is a short T=0.1 fixed-input, few-grid test, not a full circulation or long-time preservation study. The Fourier check covers selected uniform states, wave numbers and powers; it is no proof for all modes, nonlinear variable states or general positivity. Actual integration retains the acoustic CFL and does not use the displayed convective diagnostic step. Steady convergence acceleration, dual time, shock/contact robustness, general meshes and all Mach numbers remain unverified. Finite periodic-box seams, Gauss quadrature and primitive variables evaluated from cell means remain distinct qualifications. Pressure Mach dependence and local errors are retained. Unlimited MUSCL is selected for these smooth inputs, not a limiter, TVD method or general positivity guarantee. The original box-wide pressure waves are shown in a separate full-domain failed-trial figure rather than hidden by the gallery core crop. Velocity/core improvements do not imply globally better pressure: finest whole-domain pressure L1 is slightly larger with preconditioning and grows when background Mach is reduced by ten. No Mach-independent pressure accuracy follows from these measurements. Perturbation kinetic energy is a diagnostic computed from conserved cell means, not exact conservation of continuous kinetic energy. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
